role: The finished path an entity walks: the point array, the cursor and the vector helpers the navigator and the AI read.
scope_reason: Mob pathfinding is vanilla behavior the mob AI depends on.

members.name: PathEntity
members.note: struct path_ent holds the points in a slab block sized by the search (path_alloc(n)), given back with the path

members.name: getFinalPathPoint
members.note: pts[length - 1] in canEasilyReach and the avoid task

members.name: getPathPointFromIndex
members.note: points[index]: nav_path_follow and nav_update read pts[index], the same array element

members.name: getCurrentPathLength
members.note: the native code reads path->length directly

members.name: setCurrentPathLength
members.note: removeSunnyPath's trim writes path->length inside set_path

members.name: getCurrentPathIndex
members.note: the native code reads path->index directly

members.name: getVectorFromIndex
members.note: the enderman's own copy; the navigator's copy is folded into nav_update (ai.c)

members.name: isSamePath
members.note: ported inline in set_path: same point count and every point equal

members.name: isDestinationSame
members.note: the AIC_AVOID_ENTITY case's final-point x and z test

notes: Positions come back as doubles instead of Vec3 objects; the entity's width offset in getVectorFromIndex is kept exactly (hostiles_enderman.c:246). lane/idxclient: getPathPointFromIndex is an array read, ported as one; every member is exact (test_paths over pf2-20k and pf42-20k, the fight and village recordings).
